title: RenderPayloadSchema
description: Specification for the render request payload dispatched to the deterministic Python engine.

request_id.description: Unique UUID or transaction ID for the render job.

layout_id.description: Identifier of the target preset layout (e.g., 'grid_2x2', 'hero_top_3_sub').

custom_layout.description: Optional inline layout specification overriding layout_id.

photos.description: Ordered array of 4 photos corresponding directly to slot_index 0, 1, 2, 3.

slot_index.description: Target slot index in the canvas layout.

photo_id.description: Client-side identifier for tracking and swapping state.

temp_path.description: Absolute or relative file path to the staged image in .tmp/ directory.

original_filename.description: Original file name uploaded by user.

crop_focus.description: Normalized focal point (0.0 to 1.0) for deterministic center-cropping.

output_filename.description: Target filename for the generated composition.
